question.text: A trader buys 5 lots of 10-year GOI bond futures at Rs. 102.25. The daily settlement price (DSP) is Rs. 102.75. What is the MTM profit?

explanation.text: The Logic: Open futures positions are marked to the daily settlement price. With a GOI bond futures lot size of 2,000 units, MTM Profit = (DSP - Buy Price) x 2,000 x Number of lots = (102.75 - 102.25) x 2,000 x 5 = Rs. 5,000. The Trap: Rs. 2,500 uses 1,000 instead of 2,000 units per lot; Rs. 500 forgets to multiply by the number of lots; Rs. 50,000 uses 20,000 instead of 2,000. Anchor on lot size = 2,000. Note: The MTM amount is settled in cash on a T+1 basis. If the resulting margin obligation is not met, exchanges respond with alerts, stopping further trading, and ultimately withdrawal of the trading facility.
